[suggested_fix] The corrected for-loop line is:
```c
for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) sum += i;
```
This change ensures that the loop iterates from `i=1` to `i=N`, inclusive. The bug in the original code was that it stopped at `N-1` instead of `N`. By changing the loop condition to `i <= N`, the corrected code ensures that all values of `i` from 1 to `N` are included in the loop iteration.
